milo: Unchanged published reference; one separately identified final-session measurement per tool, verify cached accuracy equivalence and retain previous results.

generation.boundary_policy: At the first state requiring an unmeasured repeat-length rate, stop further indel recursion for those disjoint reads; retain them, apply substitutions, preserve origins, and report boundary read counts and labels.
generation.interpretation: Empirically informed finite-support simulation, not a measured error model beyond repeat length 13. No seeds or reads dropped based on results.
generation.stress: Prior 0x/1x/3x/10x pilot retained separately, including seven unsupported cells; no stronger rates in the primary comparison.

primary.metric: Exact-centroid F1 percentage, all designed truth including zero-read identities
primary.contrasts: LV/Poisson minus each of four external competitors, separately in random and anchored designs
primary.method: Paired library-level t differences; simultaneous one-sided lower bounds using Bonferroni alpha/8; one-sided Holm-adjusted p-values also reported.
primary.robustness: Library-paired percentile bootstrap lower bound at alpha/8, 100000 resamples, fixed analysis seed 20260912401. A superiority label requires both lower bounds >0.
primary.milo_inference: Fixed development reference; no independent-library significance claim.
primary.selection: All final libraries and conditions included. No extension, parameter changes or selecting winners after final outcomes.

secondary: read assignment accuracy and unassigned reads
paired log workflow-time ratios with descriptive 95% t intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted primary inference

execution.cache: Run each registered campaign cell once; resume only incomplete cells and verify signatures and outputs. A failed completed tool cell is retained as a failure, never silently replaced.
execution.timing_boundary: Fresh Python worker, tool/package startup, required input conversion, centroid/member export; excludes common staging, scoring and hashing.
execution.milo_remeasurement_reason: Previously cached times predate the startup change; this is the single authorized final-session comparative timing campaign, not repeated candidate tuning.

publication_claim: Report supported advantages and limitations. No requirement that barbac wins every contrast.
